column1: # Ash Jenna glimpsed in the Lamakan Desert after Mercury Lighthouse is lit.

column3:
You keep looking
for the people
you couldn't save.{page_break}I know what
that feels like.{end_wait}
You think there's\nstill time to put\neverything right.{page_break}I thought so, too.{end_wait}
Keep following them.\nThen ask yourself\nwho pays for it.{end_wait}
She looks like Jenna.\nBut that voice...{end_wait}
